title: campanula racemosa var. arctiflora
intro: Campanula racemosa var. arctiflora, commonly known as Frost Daisy, is a perennial plant species in the bellflower family, native to North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Campanula racemosa var. arctiflora include relaxing and calming effects, which may help to reduce anxiety and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
